To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the work climate of research units is influenced by the organizational factors, which in turn influence the measures of effectiveness.
the work climate of a research unit has a significant impact on the measures of effectiveness and the measures of effectiveness are affected significantly by the research environment.

(i) the work climate of a research unit has an impact on its effectiveness; (ii) the work climate is influenced by the organizational culture, management practices and the work environment of the unit; and (iii) the organizational culture of the unit is influenced by the management practices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the causal relationships among measures of effectiveness of laboratories and the factors affecting work climate of research units in CSIR.
the causal linkages among the factors of work climate and the measures of effectiveness in an R&D organization.

the following: (1) The relationship among the dimensions of the measures of effectiveness; (2) The relationship of the dimensions of the effectiveness measures with the dimensions of the work climate; (3) The relationship among dimensions of the work environment; (4) The relationship between the effectiveness measures and the work environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the measures of effectiveness (MOE) of the research units of CSIR are influenced by the factors of work climate (WCF).
there is a strong positive relationship between work climate and effectiveness of research units.
work climate has a significant positive effect on the effectiveness of research units.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the work climate of research units is affected by the organizational climate, the management style and the leadership behaviour of the unit head, and the effectiveness of the unit is influenced by the work climate of the unit.
there is a significant relationship between work climate and measures of effectiveness of R&D units in CSIR, India.
the causal model for research units is a complex one and the causal relationships are not always direct and linear.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the causal linkages among the factors of the work climate are not as strong as those among the measures of the effectiveness of research units.
the work climate of the research units of CSIR is a complex phenomenon and is affected by a variety of factors, both external and internal to the research units.
the measures of effectiveness and work climate of research units in an organization are interrelated.
